statuses.detail: Safety, admission and review fixes are merged: commands and checks run inside the boundary and timed-out commands are reaped there, model role steps without a boundary are refused, unknown model identity holds, and admission is rechecked while an attempt runs. Real-host proof of the new paths remains.

Docker boundary, cancel, timeout and lost-wrapper drills passed on Ubuntu 24.04 in WSL2 on 1 November. Service-manager, engine-restart and supervisor-restart drills (R11) remain; work on them started on 3 November.

Role-step dispatch, the generated execution contract (version 3), frozen read-only step packets (R07) and owner-enabled advisory duties (R08) are merged at cbb074a, with 701 tests OK. Container role-step transport (R05) and packet retention (R09) remain.

A direct build reached QA then stopped on tool denials (1 November). On 3 November the owner authorized the remaining live runs on the Max subscription only, with no billed API key and the cheapest adequate model and effort. None has run yet.

Registry, admission and bundle observation exist, and an attempt that reports no model now holds. The supervised assessment adapter and the container grading sandbox (R06) and a first certificate remain.
Templates exist; no registered operational service is recorded.
